SOFR is secured overnight funding; 3.90% alone does not indicate plumbing stress. NFCI is broad financial conditions; negative values indicate looser conditions (-0.56). The 10Y yield tracks duration and term-premium repricing.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Sep 30 is quarter-end and U.S. federal fiscal year-end; watch rebalancing, Treasury settlement, and funding sensitivity. NY Fed Treasury operations for Sep 15-Oct 14 indicate about $15.6B in reinvestment purchases and no reserve-management purchases.
  • Today's 8:30 AM ET PCE/income-spending, GDP third estimate, Census advance indicators, and NFCI are a concentrated rates catalyst; BLS metro labor data is at 10:00 AM. Friday payrolls and Oct 7 FOMC minutes are the next major policy repricing risks.
  • White House Sep 27 U.S.-China Board of Trade statement described product lists recommended for reduced tariff treatment, subject to domestic processes; monitor implementation headlines without inventing a timed catalyst.
  • NYSE marks Sep 30 quarterly options expiration and quarter-end. Cboe also lists Sep 30 VIX weekly and equity/index Wednesday expiries; Oct 2 is an end-of-week expiry. CME Sep quarterly futures roll and expiry (Sep 14/18) have passed. No holiday or shortened U.S. cash session occurs in this horizon.
  • The Federal Reserve has no decision before Oct 7; minutes from the Sep 15-16 meeting publish at 2:00 PM ET that day. Treasury's Oct refunding estimates $950B end-Sep cash and a temporary rise toward $1.05T in late October; keep bill supply/TGA flows on watch.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS direct schedule endpoint returned HTTP 403; current official BLS 2026 schedule, newsroom and metro release schedule were inspected via official-page fallback. Metro employment is Sep 30 10:00 AM and Employment Situation is Oct 2 8:30 AM. No CPI or PPI falls Sep 30-Oct 7.
  • TreasuryDirect verifies exact bill bid cutoffs for Sep 30's 17-week bill and Oct 1's 4- and 8-week bills. Other bill auctions and coupon-note auctions in the horizon have auction dates but no exact current cutoff/hour in official upcoming records; omitted as timed rows.
  • EIA WPSR page still shows stale Sep 23 next-release date; its general page only states the weekly Wednesday release time, so Sep 30 inventory timing is not date-specifically verified and is omitted. EIA Natural Gas Storage is verified for Oct 1. The October STEO page gives Oct 6 and a 12:00-12:15 PM ET release window, displayed as a window.
  • NAR has no housing release verified in Sep 30-Oct 7. ADP, ISM and Conference Board dates are sourced from their publishers. Market snapshot is one delayed Yahoo Finance feed; closes and overnight quotes are separately labeled.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Respect the Wednesday 8:30 AM data cluster and quarter-end positioning. MOVE is moderate while 10Y yields have risen; let ES price action and rates confirmation determine whether initial moves extend. Friday payrolls and next Wednesday's FOMC minutes remain scheduled event risk. Scenario framework, not a directional forecast.
INVALIDATION
Invalidate a range/continuation thesis if ES breaks and holds beyond the overnight range with confirmation from Treasury yields and volatility, or if data materially reprices the policy path. Not a trade signal.
